items.title: Tony Fougerat Interview, 1960-06-08
items.q: Oh, he was going strong, Jack Lane. Yeah, he was, he was really starting out. And Jack Lane was, he was playing years and years before I had started.

ctx.x: And Jack Lane was still going then, huh?
Oh, he was going strong, Jack Lane. Yeah, he was, he was really starting out. And Jack Lane was, he was playing years and years before I had started.
Yeah, I wondered when he retired. I didn't know. Oh, I didn't know.
